description: Hand-written contract examples for BBCA and ANTM. All cohort values and assignments are synthetic. The unknown-cohort row for each symbol illustrates missing evidence, not zero activity.

records.title: Institutional broker cohort
records.explanation: Synthetic example: sell value exceeds buy value by IDR 40,000,000. This describes intermediary activity, not investor identity or a trading signal.

records.title: Retail broker cohort
records.explanation: Synthetic example: buy value exceeds sell value by IDR 20,000,000. No score or severity follows from this example.

records.title: Mixed broker cohort
records.explanation: Synthetic example: positive buy and sell activity has net value zero. A zero net value does not mean inactivity.

records.title: Unknown broker cohort
records.explanation: Example only: values are unavailable and must not display as zero. Unknown cohorts can have valid values; this row illustrates an unavailable state for any cohort.
